classifications.rationale: The President establishes an Education Department initiative and directs its Executive Director and other officials to manage, coordinate, and advise; these are immediate internal organizational and policy-management actions, not changes to legal rights or eligibility.
classifications.evidence: there is established in the Department of Education (Department), the White House Initiative on Advancing Educational Equity, Excellence, and Economic Opportunity through Historically Black Colleges and Universities

classifications.rationale: The Initiative, agency heads, Executive Director, and interagency group must advise, coordinate, plan, report, monitor, and collaborate; any programmatic consequences would arise only through later discretionary agency action, and no specified legal outcome is dictated here.
classifications.evidence: The Initiative's recommendations shall include advice on advancing policies, programs, and initiatives that further the policy set out in section 1 of this order.

classifications.rationale: The Department must furnish internal administrative support, agencies may detail personnel, and the Initiative must coordinate with related initiatives; these are ongoing management and staffing directions within existing legal and appropriations limits.
classifications.evidence: The Department shall provide funding and administrative support for the Initiative and the Interagency Working Group

classifications.rationale: The Executive Director must submit an annual internal report, while the President establishes and assigns functions and membership characteristics to an advisory board; these are reporting and organizational measures.
classifications.evidence: There is established in the Department the President's Board of Advisors on Historically Black Colleges and Universities (Board).

classifications.rationale: The President must select a Board Chair and may select a Vice Chair; this is an internal assignment of leadership roles whose consequence occurs through presidential designation, not a substantive legal-rights determination.
classifications.evidence: The President shall designate one member of the Board to serve as its Chair

classifications.rationale: The President directs the Board's support, composition, ex officio membership, and delegation of presidential advisory-committee functions; the travel-expense clause merely permits reimbursement as already authorized by law, so the segment remains administrative housekeeping.
classifications.evidence: any functions of the President under that Act, except that of reporting to the Congress, shall be performed by the Chair

classifications.rationale: The President revokes and supersedes prior administrative orders, defines terminology for this order, and assigns agencies support and expense-bearing duties; these changes immediately reorganize internal executive administration without themselves altering external legal rights.
classifications.evidence: Executive Order 13779 of February 28, 2017 (White House Initiative To Promote Excellence and Innovation at Historically Black Colleges and Universities), which is hereby revoked.
